/* ChkLst01Mapper.mergeChkptInspectItemList */ INSERT INTO TB_CHKPT_INSPECT_ITEM ( CMPNY_CD , CHKLST_TYPE , INSPECT_ITEM_CD , INSPECT_ITEM_SUBJ , SORT_IDX , STR_DATE , USE_YN , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE , UPDATE_NO , UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES( #{gvCmpnyCd} , #{chkLstType} , IFNULL( #{inspectItemCd} , CONCAT( 'DCHK' , '_' , CAST(#{chkLstType} AS UNSIGNED) , '_' , FNC_CMM_SEQ_NEXTVAL(#{gvCmpnyCd}, CONCAT('COM001-', #{chkLstType}))) ) , #{inspectItemSubj} , #{sortIdx}
, SUBSTRING(REPLACE(#{strDate}, '-', ''), 1, 8) , #{useYn} , #{gvUserCd} , now() , #{gvUserCd} , now() ) AS NEW ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE INSPECT_ITEM_SUBJ = NEW.INSPECT_ITEM_SUBJ , SORT_IDX = NEW.SORT_IDX , STR_DATE = NEW.STR_DATE , USE_YN = IFNULL(NEW.USE_YN, 'Y') , UPDATE_NO = NEW.UPDATE_NO , UPDATE_DATE = NOW()
mapper.select: /* ChkLst02Mapper.selectChkptInspectItem */ SELECT '' AS chk , A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.CHKLST_TYPE AS chkLstType , A.INSPECT_ITEM_CD AS inspectItemCd , A.INSPECT_ITEM_SUBJ AS inspectItemSubj , A.SORT_IDX AS sortIdx , A.STR_DATE AS strDate , A.USE_YN AS useYn FROM TB_CHKPT_INSPECT_ITEM A WHERE 1=1 AND A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.CHKLST_TYPE = #{chkLstType} AND A.INSPECT_ITEM_CD = #{inspectItemCd}
/* ChkLst02Mapper.selectNextInspectItemCd */ SELECT CONCAT( 'DCHK' , '_' , CAST(#{chkLstType} AS UNSIGNED) , '_' , FNC_CMM_SEQ_NEXTVAL(#{gvCmpnyCd}, CONCAT('COM001-', #{chkLstType})) )

/* ChkLst02Mapper.selectChkptInspectItemHistList */ SELECT H.CHG_TYPE AS chgType
, CASE H.CHG_TYPE WHEN '01' THEN '등록' WHEN '02' THEN '수정' WHEN '03' THEN '사용중지' WHEN '04' THEN '재사용' ELSE H.CHG_TYPE END AS chgTypeNm , H.INSPECT_ITEM_SUBJ AS inspectItemSubj , H.STR_DATE AS strDate , H.SORT_IDX AS sortIdx , H.USE_YN AS useYn , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(H.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', H.INSERT_NO, NULL) AS chgUserNm , DATE_FORMAT(H.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS chgDtime FROM TB_CHKPT_INSPECT_ITEM_HIST H WHERE 1=1 AND H.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND H.CHKLST_TYPE = #{chkLstType} AND H.INSPECT_ITEM_CD = #{inspectItemCd} ORDER BY H.INSERT_DATE DESC, H.HIST_ID DESC
mapper.insert: /* ChkLst02Mapper.insertChkptInspectItemHist */ INSERT INTO TB_CHKPT_INSPECT_ITEM_HIST ( CMPNY_CD , CHKLST_TYPE , INSPECT_ITEM_CD , CHG_TYPE , INSPECT_ITEM_SUBJ , STR_DATE , SORT_IDX , USE_YN , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE ) SELECT A.CMPNY_CD , A.CHKLST_TYPE , A.INSPECT_ITEM_CD , #{chgType} , A.INSPECT_ITEM_SUBJ , A.STR_DATE , A.SORT_IDX , A.USE_YN , #{cmd.gvUserCd} , NOW() FROM TB_CHKPT_INSPECT_ITEM A WHERE 1=1 AND A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmd.gvCmpnyCd} AND A.CHKLST_TYPE = #{cmd.chkLstType} AND A.INSPECT_ITEM_CD = #{cmd.inspectItemCd}
